text:
maria: Quick sync after today's runbook rehearsal for Lazuli priv/VPC onboarding. TL;DR: core infra passes smoke tests but three high-visibility asks remain: 1) customer firewall still needs to accept peering + provide BGP ASN, 2) KMS must be HSM-origin with rotation evidence and a signed attestation, 3) audit logs must meet 7y immutable retention requirement. Calling out owners and next steps below.

jonah: Networking recap: transit gw + attachments healthy, route propagation ok, flow logs delivered to staging bucket. Peering request sent last week; firewall team asked for sample IKE/BGP policies and crystalized MTU/Jumbo framing. I posted the snippet to INF-6022. Blocker: their firewall squad’s change window is Thu overnight.

maria: Noted. Can you push an explicit change window request and ask them to confirm the ASN by EOD Wed?

jonah: Will do. Also found intermittent route flap during the rehearsal (5min window) — I captured the route table dump and attached to INF-6022. Looks like a BGP med mismatch; shipping a sample config to their team.

tara: Security/KMS: customer insists on HSM-origin CMK (they referenced FIPS 140-2 L3). They require rotation evidence every 24 months and per-request audit logs showing key ID + calling principal. I'll prepare an "attestation package" template (short pdf + sample logs) they can consume. Question: do they accept CloudHSM-backed KMS or do they require third-party HSM vendor certs?

samir: From account convos, they prefer vendor attestation but may accept CloudHSM cert docs. I'll confirm with their security lead tonight.

nina: Audit logs: customer wants Splunk ingestion + 7y immutability (WORM). Two feasible tracks: A) Redwood provision object-locked S3 + legal addendum for WORM retention as a paid addon, B) our default 3y + automated monthly export to their archive provider (they mentioned IronVault) with notarized hashes. Pricing estimate required for both.

maria: Good. Alex used to own pricing on these — but Alex is OOO; samir can you draft a quick cost delta for option A vs B (ballpark % uplift) so legal/pricing can triage?

samir: I can. Ballpark: option A ~ +12% storage OPEX (long-term cold tier + object-lock overhead) vs option B ~ +8% (we store 3y + transfer costs). I'll firm numbers once we get GB/month.

tara: Also, small IAM note: our assume-role policy must limit sts:AssumeRole to their account principals only. No wildcard principals; include MFA condition if they ask.

maria: Action list recap: jonah -> chase firewall change window confirmation + push route flap trace into INF-6022 (owner: jonah, due Wed EOD). tara -> assemble attestation package + sample per-request KMS logs (owner: tara, due Thu noon). samir -> draft cost delta for A vs B and include transfer estimates (owner: samir, due Thu EOD). nina -> request Splunk HEC endpoint, sourcetype mappings, and monthly ingest GB from the customer (owner: nina, due Wed EOD). I'll update account health and flag renewal risk as "elevated" until retention path is agreed. CS bot create follow-ups.

cs_bot: Created CS-10021 "Lazuli runbook follow-ups: peering confirm, KMS attestation, 7y audit retention" assigned to maria.

jonah: Command snippets I used during rehearsal: `aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=association.subnet-id,Values=subnet-0a1b2c` and `aws cloudwatch get-metric-data --metric-name BGPRouteFlaps --start-time 2024-03-01`. Attached sample outputs to INF-6022.

tara: Example per-request log (sanitized): {"time":"2024-03-12T15:02:03Z","keyId":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd","principal":"arn:aws:iam::999:role/Lazuli-Client","operation":"GenerateDataKey","status":"OK"} — will include more rows in attestation.

nina: For compliance, they want signed attestations stating keys were HSM-origin. I'll add a checklist to the ticket listing acceptable artifacts (CloudHSM cert chain, KMS import evidence, CloudHSM cluster serials).

maria: Legal engagement: legal_bot, can you queue a short addendum template for WORM retention + responsibilities? We want minimal friction for customer sign-off.

legal_bot: Drafting a short addendum template and will post to CS-10021 by Thu. Includes responsibilities, data ownership, and termination cleanup.

maria: Excellent. Renewal risk guidance: until we can promise 7y immutability or an approved addendum, mark renewal risk as elevated (score: 6/9). If customer insists on vendor-provided HSM certs only, that may bump to high.

samir: I'll prioritize pricing numbers; will ping if I need byte counts.

maria: OK team — please update CS-10021 as you make progress. If any owner hits red before Thu, drop a short note here. :thumbsup:

jonah: Ack, will chase firewall and post ASN confirmation when received.

tara: Ack, starting the attestation draft now.

nina: Ack, pinging customer for Splunk details now.

samir: Ack, will have ballpark numbers Thu EOD.

maria: Thanks all. End of thread.
